topic: Both exterior-trace conjectures in OEIS A322844, Comments, conjectures block, revision 68
title: Rank-two extensions of Spezia's 2018 determinant result: the two conjectures in OEIS A322844, Comments (revision 68)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Spezia's determinant result (2018), we prove his two conjectures in OEIS A322844, Comments, the two statements in the conjectures block (revision 68, August 23, 2025): the absolute second exterior trace of the serpentine matrix is the stated quartic quasipolynomial, and every exterior trace of order greater than two vanishes. The matrix has rank exactly two for every size at least two. A factorization through a two-dimensional space gives its characteristic polynomial, including the sign of the second exterior trace. Corollaries give a minimal polynomial, a permanent formula, diagonal sums, generating functions and reciprocal sums. We distinguish the exponential generating function from a shifted-factorial expression in the source.
summary: Rank two gives the complete characteristic polynomial, signed second exterior trace and zero higher exterior maps, extending Spezia's recorded 2018 determinant formula. Corollaries cover the linked matrix statistics and the scalar generating functions and reciprocal sums, with explicit corrections to factorial weights and printed formulas.

posing_source.locator: Comments, the two assertions between Conjectures: (Start) and (End), revision 68 dated 2025-08-23
posing_source.author: Stefano Spezia

related_prior_result.author: Stefano Spezia
related_prior_result.scope: Determinant 1 at size 1, -5 at size 2, zero above size 2; the latter is the top-exterior-order subcase, not all intermediate exterior traces.

written_proofs: zero exterior maps above degree two
step-two recurrences and full/parity ordinary generating functions
conventional, shifted-factorial and parity-weighted exponential generating functions
seven reciprocal sums across A322844, A002415 and A037270
linked i+j and i-j characteristic polynomials and ranks, with prior attribution
squared-difference identity and scalar generating functions of A002415
nearest-diagonal parity and superdiagonal final-digit property

finite_checks.additional_numerical_check: 4096 terms for each reciprocal series, with explicit tail bounds

lean_declarations.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.SpeziaSerpentineHigherExteriorTrace.result
lean_declarations.statement: For all natural n and k > 2, the characteristic-coefficient exterior trace is zero.

lean_declarations.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.SpeziaSerpentineSecondExteriorTrace.result
lean_declarations.statement: For all n > 1, the absolute second characteristic-coefficient exterior trace equals a_n.

lean_declarations.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.SpeziaSerpentineSecondExteriorTrace.charpoly_factor
lean_declarations.statement: For n >= 2, the characteristic polynomial of the rational image of M_n is x^(n-2) times the characteristic polynomial of V_n U_n.

lean_declarations.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Matrix.SpeziaSerpentineSecondExteriorTrace.coefficient_two
lean_declarations.statement: For n >= 2, the rational image of the characteristic coefficient of degree n-2 is -a_n.
